text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian conquered the Japanese
Derby. 
Her desire for victory burned even
fiercer 
than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Expectations from the public continue to 
swell. Whispers began to spread that at 
this rate, she might even be able to aim 
for five GⅠ victories.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Hishi Amazon had achieved the 
second Tiara crown. The two decided to 
settle things at the Arima Kinen after
the 
Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian lets her fighting spirit
boil 
over. First, to seize the Kikuka Sho, the 
final leg of the Classic Triple Crown—!
